visual.summary: Both widths show the punchline, a five-box sequence on one line, tables and sections, with no sideways overflow and readable text; the card-level review is not shown on these screenshots.

held: ambiguous: The decision "Did we get it right? Test every link first, and say what it is for." could be read as approving the whole five-step path or only the link-testing rule, and a stranger cannot tell what "Not quite" does beyond "tell us by voice".

reader.asked: Decide whether the card's rule, to test every link first and say what it is for, is what he meant by the dead-end complaint, and approve it or ask for a rewrite.
